To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the corporate governance of Swiss foundations is in a good state.

foundations should: • Establish a clear vision, mission, values and strategic goals. • Develop an impact oriented business plan. • Set up a corporate governance structure that is appropriate to the foundation’s mission and size. • Appoint a competent board that is committed to the foundation’s vision and mission. • Ensure that board members are well trained and that they have access to the necessary resources.
• Foundations should formalise their corporate governance to increase their impact.
